stories.title: Man wanted since 2023 over Chester drugs investigation arrested in Thailand
stories.summary: A man wanted for almost three years over drug supply in Chester has been arrested in Thailand. Christopher Kelsey, 30, was traced to an address in Pattaya after enquiries by Chester Proactive CID, supported by the National Crime Agency and Interpol. stories.title: Young people claiming out-of-work benefits in Flintshire up 24% in a year
stories.summary: The number of young people claiming out-of-work benefits in Flintshire has risen by almost a quarter in a year.
